report.summary: In render.py _untracked(), scanned module paths are not normalized to forward slashes before comparing with git ls-files output (which is normalized). On Windows, paths with backslashes cause all scanned files to appear untracked, breaking Stamp.describes_revision guarantee and docstring claim.
risks: Incorrect untracked_scanned count on Windows, leading to inaccurate staleness stamp and potentially hiding actual untracked files.
todos: Normalize scanned paths in _untracked() by replacing backslashes with forward slashes before set membership test.

handoff.suggestion: In _untracked(), add `scanned = tuple(p.replace('\\', '/') for p in scanned)` at the start to ensure consistency with tracked path normalization (line ~215).
